overview.description: The Principal CLO ETF (UUPP) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF investing in collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and other floating rate securities. It uses fundamental, technical, and valuation methods to select securities. UUPP was launched on May 21, 2026 and is issued by Principal.
